subject.title: fix(qqbot): require own account credential entries

question: Should QQBot formally treat only own account entries and own credential fields as supported mutable configuration across setup, resolution, and logout?
rationale: This hardens a credential boundary but intentionally changes behavior for prototype-backed programmatic config objects, so the QQBot owner should confirm that those shapes are outside the supported contract.

options.title: Adopt the own-property boundary
options.body: Keep the consistent own-property implementation, require exact-head file write/readback proof, and treat prototype-inherited QQBot values as unsupported.

options.title: Preserve inherited programmatic config
options.body: Retain inherited reads and narrow cleanup changes, with explicit compatibility tests and documentation explaining why prototype-backed configuration remains supported.

options.title: Pause pending contract definition
options.body: Leave the PR open until the supported programmatic QQBot config shape and credential ownership rules are documented.

recommendation.title: Adopt the own-property boundary
recommendation.body: Keep the consistent own-property implementation, require exact-head file write/readback proof, and treat prototype-inherited QQBot values as unsupported.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository assigns QQ and related Chinese-channel ownership to sliverp, who also appears in the originating QQBot engine history.
